# Province view: ROOT = selected province, FROM = viewing country.


custom_button = {
	name = DA_Mega_Engineering_Province_Button
	tooltip = DA_Mega_Engineering_Province_Button_tt
	potential = {
		owned_by = FROM
		OR = {
			FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.mega_engineering }
			DA_ME_province_has_any = yes
		}
	}
	trigger = { owned_by = FROM }
	effect = {
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_medicine_open
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_fortifications_open
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_province_mega_engineering_open }
				clr_country_flag = DA_province_mega_engineering_open
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = DA_province_mega_engineering_open
				hidden_effect = { DA_ME_recount = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
